title: Esrbespoke media band
description: A full-bleed, full-window photo band whose picture drifts slower than the page as it passes (scrubbed parallax).
notes: empty, it is a muted placeholder of the same size
parallax is CSS scroll-driven inside @supports, off under reduced motion
name: esrbespoke-media-band

props.name: media
props.description: the photo or film (fills like object-fit: cover). Empty: a placeholder

props.name: label
props.description: what the picture shows, for screen readers (when media is an image, give it its own alt)
